verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's documented Platforms solution covers all three parts of the story. It lets marketplaces and Payfacs onboard sub-entities and process payments for them, split funds between the platform and sub-entities, and pay sub-entities out in their local currency and preferred method. Supporting pieces include an idempotent /transfers endpoint, payout-level reconciliation reports and bank payouts testing. missing for 10: detailed onboarding/KYC API documentation for sub-entities, specifics on how splits are configured (fixed/percentage, per-payment rules), independent or hands-on corroboration.
